meta.mo_ta: Khoang tham chieu sinh hoa mau + nuoc tieu dung de quyet dinh in dam (cao hon)/in nghieng (thap hon) va bt/x. Cap nhat 30/09/2026 theo phieu Ket Qua Xet Nghiem thuc te (BN Tran Hue An, mau LIS41199905, lay mau 22/08/2026) Jo gui - da doc lai ro rang toan bo bang, thay the cac gia tri tam truoc do. Cap nhat 11/11/2026: Glucose mau chinh lai 3.90-6.50 mmol/L theo yeu cau Jo.

glucose.ghi_chu: Cap nhat 11/11/2026 theo yeu cau Jo: khoang tham chieu Glucose mau 3.90-6.50 mmol/L (khop phieu xet nghiem thuc te cua Tram Y te, lay mau 02/11/2026), thay cho 3.90-5.90 truoc do.

hdl.ghi_chu: Cap nhat 30/09/2026 theo phieu xet nghiem thuc te Jo gui (can tren doc ro la 6.00), thay cho khoang tam 0.90-2.30 truoc do.

dinh_tinh._mo_ta: 12/11/2026 (yeu cau Jo): chi so DINH TINH nuoc tieu theo 2 kieu report/don vi. 'toi_da' = gia tri LON NHAT con coi la trong tham chieu; lon hon -> NT ghi x (in dam, to do). Ket qua dang chu Negative/Am tinh/Normal/Binh thuong luon la trong tham chieu. Nitrit la cot ma hoa (1 = am tinh, 0 = duong tinh). Nguong do Claude de xuat theo thang que thu nuoc tieu thong dung - CAN Jo xac nhan.

kieu_1._mo_ta: Phieu dang Negative/Normal, don vi quy uoc (hinh Jo gui): Leukocyte Cell/uL, Keton mg/dL, Urobilinogen mg/dL, Bilirubin mg/dL, Protein mg/dL, Glucose mg/dL, Blood Cell/uL

kieu_2._mo_ta: Bang thong ke LIS don vi SI: Bach cau Leu/uL, Hong cau Ery/uL, Protein g/L, Glucose mmol/L, The cetonic mmol/L, Bilirubin umol/L, Urobilinogen umol/L
